description: Set gain (number, ramped) or mute (boolean) on selected mixer outputs (Mixer.SetOutput{Gain,Mute}). This MUTATES the running/emulated system. Read mixer state back via qsys_get_component.

outputs.description: Output selector — QRC String Syntax: "*" (all), "1 2 3"/"1,2,3" (list), "1-6" (range), "!3" (negate), combinable ("1-8 !3")

ramp.description: Ramp time in seconds — gain only, ignored otherwise

value.description: Number (dB) for gain; boolean for mute

name: qsys_mixer_set_output
title: Set mixer output(s)
